constants.WRAPPED_NOTE: A list standing for one optional object: empty for none, otherwise exactly one item.
constants.ANSWER_TOOL_DESC: Give FERB your final answer for this message: call this once, when you have decided, with the whole answer as its input (one object matching this input schema). Include every property; use null where the schema allows it for a value that doesn't apply. FERB acts on this answer; nothing you call in the same reply runs.
constants.PLANNER_ANSWER: FERB's answer format (required): your lookup tools are for you, not for a task. When the owner asks about something from before (a detail of an earlier answer, what an earlier task found or did, something they told you, memory), call the lookups yourself first and answer from what they return: a short-form result's full text is one chat.history call with its entry_id, an earlier task's records are task.evidence with its task_id. Never make a task just to read FERB's own records; when a task needs something from an earlier result (a file it made, the values to send), name that result's Result id in the task's earlier_results instead of reading it into the goal: FERB gives the worker its full text. Then give your final answer by calling the ferb_answer tool with the whole answer (its input schema is the answer format), or reply with only that JSON object, nothing before or after it.
constants.FOLLOW_UP: You ended without an answer. Give your final answer now.
constants.NOT_RUN_WITH_ANSWER: Not run: your answer came in the same reply.
constants.ANSWER_NOT_TAKEN: Not taken: the owner updated the request; answer again using the new instructions.
